systemTagsNote: These tags are applied by Red Hat and cannot be edited or removed.
clusterTagsDescription: Cluster AWS tags are applied to the AWS resources created for this cluster, including all machine pools.
inheritedTagTooltip: Inherited from the cluster. Change the value to override it for this machine pool.
inheritedTagRemoveReason: Inherited tags can't be removed from a machine pool. Remove them from the cluster instead.
